completion_contract.agentdojo_method_work: Finish each disclosed component, document local choices, test it under frozen local reference contracts, and label unsupported claims explicitly.

completion_contract.no_pooling: Keep TaintBench provenance, transfer unsafe-label scores, unsafe-review cascade, and local AgentDojo experiments separate.
